thesis: The partnership is a dated product development but has no quantified economic impact; reported FCF is negative and technicals remain weak below all moving averages.
strongest_counterexample: The strongest counterexample is rapid adoption/monetization of SoFiUSD settlement plus stabilization near the 52-week low; no supplied evidence shows either yet.
invalidation_conditions: A close below the observed 60-bar low would weaken the stabilization case.
evidence_gaps: Partnership uptake/revenue and credit-quality data are absent.
Financial period underlying negative FCF is unknown.
decisive_factors: Price is below SMA-20/50/200 and down 44.48% over 252 bars.
News includes a live partnership but no adoption measure.
